cases.notes: Canonical asserted direction must survive round-trip.
Inverse projection does not gain independent evidentiary standing.
Unknown relation remains distinguishable from Standard-defined core semantics.
Same SPO tuple with distinct actor/evidence must not collapse.
Exact replay may collapse only by governed record identity.
Symmetric traversal may normalize without inventing evidence.
Cycles are permitted when relation semantics do not forbid them.
Prohibited cycle is diagnosed without deleting history.
No private tiebreak selects an authoritative head.
Projection must not silently drop unresolved relation.
Ambiguous locator cannot override governed identity.
Path movement does not create new governed target identity.
Unavailability is explicit; no fabricated resolution.
Contradiction does not collapse one assertion into the other.
Correction must not delete original evidence/assertion history.
Superseded record remains queryable as historical evidence.
Overlapping validity does not create automatic authority precedence.
Projection rebuild may differ internally but must preserve portable meaning.
